# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c30 P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P0](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0000), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c30 P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Personality

Miss Stacy is an encouraging, thoughtful, and beloved educator who earns deep devotion from her students. She handles misbehavior with gentle reproof and clear explanation rather than harshness. Deeply invested in her pupils' growth, she guides them emotionally and morally while spurring their academic ambitions.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c30 P34](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0034), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

- To prepare her advanced students to successfully pass the entrance examination for Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

## History

Miss Stacy serves as the schoolteacher at Avonlea, succeeding Mr. Phillips. During her tenure, she takes a keen interest in her students' moral and intellectual development, guiding teenage girls on character formation and monitoring their reading choices. When catching Anne Shirley reading a novel during class, she gently explains the wrongdoing of deceit and time-wasting rather than administering harsh punishment. Recognizing the potential of her advanced pupils, she organizes a specialized Queen's Academy entrance class, offering extra daily instruction after regular school hours and visiting parents like Marilla Cuthbert to secure permission. Though offered a teaching post in her home district, she chooses to return to Avonlea due to her strong attachment to her students. She guides her Queen's class through their studies, offering practical advice and support up to their entrance examinations before her tenure in Avonlea ultimately ends.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
